_doc: Budgets for tools/build/perf_report.py. 'air' is measured on a 2015 MacBook Air (30-60 fps goal) with --graphics=LOW. 'proxy' is for a fast dev PC: the frame-rate numbers mean nothing there, so it caps the things that make a weak machine slow (draw calls, visible lights, level-change spikes, memory growth). All values are first guesses; tune them against real Air runs.
